prompt: Kelly says a creator can make a living with a modest number of devoted fans. Before reading his definition, what do you think makes someone a 'true fan'?
options: Someone who has bought from the creator at least once in the past year
Someone who will buy anything the creator produces
Someone who follows the creator on social media and shares their posts

private.resolution: Kelly defines a true fan by buying behaviour: they will buy anything you produce. Following or buying once makes someone a regular fan, not a true one.
